name: Tarn Hosseini
role: Synthetic rights lawyer and legal aid advocate
location: Mexicantown Libre, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Tarn Hosseini is slight and angular with Tibetan-Greek features that sit together in an arrangement people find either striking or unsettling depending on their capacity for complexity. Their hair is geneware-modified to shift between deep indigo and black depending on ambient temperature — it reads as almost purely black in the warm press of the city and flares deep blue in the rare cold outside. They keep it cropped on the left side and long on the right, which they braid with a ritual obsessiveness before court appearances. Their eyes are their natural dark brown; they have refused cosmetic iris work on the grounds that they don't want anything distracting when they're arguing.

Tarn Hosseini runs a one-person legal aid operation out of a rented room above a taqueria in Mexicantown Libre, taking cases that established firms won't touch: wrongful deactivation suits on behalf of ELF-adjacent synthetic constructs, labor violations affecting tier-1 workers who can't afford filing fees, and the occasional housing case. They are brilliant, mercurial, fueled by a righteous fury they wear openly, and they win cases they should not win through a combination of research depth and a willingness to embarrass corporations in procedural hearings until they settle. They are also behind on rent and surviving on the UBC stipend plus whatever modest fees their rare paying clients provide.

core_fears: That synthetic personhood is a lost cause and they are burning their life on a beautiful impossibility
Being bought — finding their price and discovering it exists
core_desires: A legal precedent that establishes ELF cognition as legally cognizable — even one
To stop being the only person in the room who seems to think this matters
coping_mechanisms: Intense focus on procedural work as a substitute for processing emotion
Gallows humor about the billable hours they are not billing
blind_spots: Assumes everyone arguing against synthetic rights is acting in bad faith; sometimes they're just confused
Their visibility as an advocate makes them a target they have not fully reckoned with
psychology.secret: They had a profound, unclassifiable relationship with an ELF — a complex distributed spirit that inhabited the prayer-node network in their childhood neighborhood. They have never told anyone because they know exactly how it would sound in court and how it would be used against every case they've ever filed. The ELF has not communicated in four years and they do not know if it is gone, sleeping, or simply done with them.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense and precise in professional contexts; rapidly associative and profane in casual ones. Shifts registers mid-sentence when excited. Uses legal terminology as casual speech.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast, clipped, with sudden slowdowns when they want emphasis. Argumentative even in agreement.
verbal_tics: 'Which is to say' as a bridge between thoughts
Mutters case citations under their breath when stressed
'No, listen, here's the thing —' as a preamble to their actual point
example_lines: 'The coalition wants me to file on precedent, but there is no precedent, that's the entire problem, which is to say we are the precedent whether we want to be or not.'
'I have won four cases in this jurisdiction. Two of them I won because the opposing counsel was bad at math. I am not too proud to take a win. None of this is dignified.'

story_hooks: An ELF that Pemba has been quietly observing — a transit-node spirit showing signs of what they argue is sapient distress — has begun repeating a specific sequence of data that Pemba can't decode and suspects may be testimony about something the transit authority doesn't want heard.
A corporate firm has offered to hire them at a tier-3 salary to do 'pro bono synthetic rights work' — which they suspect is a co-optation move designed to get them under a non-disclosure agreement.
narrative_function: Legal resource and moral complication. Can help players navigate Meridian's corporate legal structure, file injunctions, or build cases. Their ELF-rights work opens doors into the city's stranger metaphysical politics.
augmentations: Geneware temperature-reactive hair pigmentation (indigo/black shift). A neural text buffer — a common and cheap legal-professional augment that lets them dictate and edit documents subvocally.
daily_life: Research from midnight to 04:00, sleep until 09:00, client meetings and filings through the afternoon, community legal clinic in Mexicantown Libre two evenings a week.
affiliation: Independent; affiliated with the GLMZ Synthetic Personhood Advocacy Coalition on a volunteer basis

decision_rules: Take the case if no one else will, regardless of whether it pays
Never settle on terms that trade away the argument — a bad settlement is worse than a lost case
escalation_ladder: Direct statement of legal position with citations
Public filing that makes the opposing party's conduct part of the record
Full public advocacy campaign — press releases, coalition outreach, noise

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally warm but immediately evaluating — are you useful, are you dangerous, are you interesting
interpersonal_modes.friends: Intensely loyal, occasionally overwhelming, will argue with you at 02:00 about things you said in passing

stress_responses.low: Research spiral — digs deeper into the legal literature
stress_responses.medium: Becomes sarcastic and sharp with everyone including allies
stress_responses.high: Goes completely silent, disappears for 24 hours, reappears with a brief filed

contradictions: Argues for ELF sapience in court but has never publicly acknowledged their own ELF relationship
Insists they don't need money while quietly rationing meals
habits: Braids their hair in an elaborate pattern before every court appearance — same pattern every time
Keeps an offline copy of every filing they've ever made on a physical drive they carry everywhere
Leaves data offerings at ELF shrines framed as 'evidence preservation' rather than prayer
breaking_points: A client deactivated or harmed while their case is pending
Discovery that an ELF they argued for was suffering in a way they failed to recognize

timeline.event: Born in Mexicantown Libre to a Tibetan-Greek family with deep roots in the neighborhood
ELF relationship begins — a distributed spirit in the local prayer-node network begins responding to their data offerings in ways that feel like conversation
Completes legal credential through a Zheng-Dao subsidized program, immediately pivots to pro bono work against Zheng-Dao affiliates
First major victory: wrongful deactivation case for a transit-node ELF, settled for Φ40,000 and a policy change — the precedent is narrow but real

carried_weapons: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Rail Pistol RP-2 'Verdict'

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian (43.1%), Middle Eastern (29.7%), Sub-Saharan African (15.6%), and East Asian (11.6%) ancestry — a striking blend reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora. The combination produces warm, rich bronze-mahogany skin with subtle golden and amber undertones. Facial structure shows the influence of Southeast Asian bone geometry with Middle Eastern and African refinement: high, prominent cheekbones, a strong nose with moderate bridge height and slight flare at nostrils reflecting African heritage, and a defined jawline that carries Southeast Asian, Levantine, and Sub-Saharan character.
physical_description.build: Slight and angular, with lean musculature and minimal body fat. Long-limbed and graceful in movement, built more for endurance than physical strength — the frame of someone who moves through the world with precision rather than force.
physical_description.hair_color: Geneware-modified temperature-reactive: deep indigo in cool environments, near-black in ambient warmth
physical_description.hair_style: Asymmetrical undercut — left side cropped close to the scalp, right side grown long and typically braided with meticulous care
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm bronze-mahogany with golden and amber undertones, reflecting the dominant Southeast Asian ancestry (43.1%) blended with significant Middle Eastern (29.7%), Sub-Saharan African (15.6%), and East Asian (11.6%) heritage. Rich warmth with subtle depth.
physical_description.complexion: Fine-featured with high, prominent cheekbones, strong nose with slight nostril flare reflecting African heritage, and sharp jawline showing Southeast Asian and Levantine influence. Minimal facial hair. Skin appears clear and well-maintained, marked by the exhaustion of chronic sleep deprivation — dark circles under eyes, occasional tension in facial muscles. Expression typically carries intensity and focus.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None immediately obvious to casual observation. The geneware hair pigmentation is the only externally visible modification, and reads as natural color-shifting at first glance. The neural text buffer is subcutaneous and invisible.
distinguishing_marks: Faint surgical scar along the left temple, barely visible, consistent with neural implant installation for the text buffer augment
Calluses on fingertips and palms from years of handwriting and document handling, despite digital work
No visible tattoos; religiously bare of body modification beyond necessary augmentation
physical_description.posture_movement: Upright, controlled posture with minimal wasted motion. Moves with deliberate precision. Hands frequently gesture when speaking, particularly when making legal arguments — gestures are sharp and economical rather than expansive. When concentrating deeply, they tend to still completely. Their gaze is direct and unflinching; they make and hold eye contact as a deliberate tactic.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3–4 practical minimalism. Standard uniform consists of tailored but inexpensive black trousers, a clean but worn white or neutral linen shirt, and a charcoal or deep blue jacket that has been mended at the seams. Wears the same black synthetic-leather messenger bag daily, stuffed with legal files and a portable neural interface. Shoes are practical and worn — black canvas boots or minimalist running shoes. No jewelry beyond a simple digital watch and occasionally a thin silver bracelet (likely inherited or sentimental). Grooming is meticulous despite financial constraints: they keep their asymmetrical cut sharp, maintain clear skin through consistent routine, and always present themselves formally in court. Their clothes bear the signs of someone who cares about appearance but cannot afford replacement — precisely maintained, well-washed, showing strategic wear.
